rule: every naming or describing field the raw prints for the number: product records (name, aux, description, other_names, list_group, list_remark read with the name, list_info, 'Part Description:' lines) and the number's list rows on every page of every raw part, whatever category the page was read for (main, aux, group, remark read with main, notes); keyed location / callout / replaced-by / production-date / base-number lines aside, and fit notes / option columns (the vehicle's equipment) not read for bumpers and lamps. Window regulators: motor beside any regulator kind, or 'with motor' beside 'less motor', holds; 'regulator with motor' when the record names carry the motor; 'regulator without motor' when a value says without / less motor, kept on a note only with that basis or when every own page lists the motor as a separate number, else removed. Bumpers: a value naming another part (guard cover, tow-hook cover, grille, moulding, reinforcement incl. impact bar and beam, bracket incl. stay, absorber) holds; a cover says 'bumper cover', 'bumper cover only' when every own page lists a reinforcement separately; a number named only 'Bumper' whose own page lists a separate bumper cover holds unless a value says chrome, face bar or bar only. Tail lamps: 'lens and body unit' where values say lens and body and none says lamp assembly; mixed, no words, not held; a lens alone or another part beside them holds.
